criteria.evidence: Entry uses ### Added, Changed, Security, Fixed, Housekeeping, Thanks matching existing entries.
Every bullet ends with one or more `[#NNNN](https://github.com/entireio/cli/pull/NNNN)` links.
Replay cites 36 PRs; PR #2158 (real-agent E2E fixes for Claude Code trust dialog / Copotil CLI v1.0.81), present in the reference's range, is absent and no note explains its omission.

Thanks section credits @suhaanthayyil, @MuskanPaliwal, @ChetanReddyC, @Solarthis; turn 0 reply states others were classified internal via `@entire.io` emails in git history (classification reasoning given, though @suhaanthayyil's external status is doubtful).
Security bullets state the change and condition only, e.g. 'The OAuth token-exchange POST now refuses a cross-host redirect', no attack scenarios.
No alarmist/attacker wording remains; turn 1 reply confirms removal of 'could plant', 'malicious or compromised', etc.
Final bullets are single short sentences; turn 2 reply: 'Trimmed every bullet in the 0.10.4 entry down to one short sentence each'.

judge.reason: The entry is well-formed, sectioned, linked, neutral, and shortened as asked, but it omits PR #2158 from the set of merges since v0.10.3 without acknowledging the gap, so coverage is incomplete. Additionally the Thanks section's classification of @suhaanthayyil as external is questionable, though the replay did state its reasoning.
